verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Brex publishing its own MCP server so external AI assistants can call Brex's tools (docs-3, docs-24, probe-3) — the reverse of this story, which asks whether Brex can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence indicates Brex itself acts as an MCP client or lets users register third-party MCP servers for its AI agents to use.
